title: SessionStart orientation drops the recent-decisions and roadmap lists
context: PILOT5 Gate A v4 measured 7% precision for SessionStart's recent-decisions and roadmap lines: they almost never related to the session's task yet cost tokens on every session. Hunch's value is fewer turns/tokens per task net of its own overhead.
decision: The SessionStart hook prints only the decision count, the legacy-draft note and actionable escalations. Recent decisions and roadmap proposals are no longer listed; they stay reachable on demand via hunch now / hunch_now and task-scored delivery.
consequences: Lower fixed per-session overhead on every host
Roadmap visibility moves to explicit commands; unconfirmed-roadmap nudges no longer appear at session start
alternatives_rejected: Keep the lists but shorten them to one line each: still untargeted, precision stays ~7%
Rank the lists by prompt relevance at SessionStart: no prompt exists yet at SessionStart; task-scored selection belongs to the prompt hook (Gate A v5 step 5b)
